Category preferences enforced at server delivery and local notification presentation, persisted per account. Recipient-bound Android delivery and logout token removal.
Configurable 22–07 silence by saved device timezone, applied to server APNs sound and native presentation; boundary tests.
JPEG/PNG/WebP metadata sanitized on both optimized and original-byte fallbacks; animated frames preserved. Only essential color/animation/orientation retained.
Authenticated own-account server export plus only current device parking; native JSON save/share sheet, no automatic sending or other-account data.
Unsupported carbon-saving switch retired; stored legacy preference preserved without claiming nonexistent behavior.
Radar preference persisted per account; existing temporary activation during user-initiated parking retained and explained.
Server-backed visible ranking and caller position; no hardcoded Palermo or device-local ranking.
Server points, confirmed activity and actual next threshold; genuine coupon API preserved.

Server participant-authorized threads/messages; existing participant-only local adoption/sighting threads explicitly labelled local. Fixed demo chat, presence, meeting and reward text removed; unavailable thread safe.
Profile points, role and calculated level refreshed from server on session and wallet/ranking reads.
Footer reads actual native app version/build.
Camera-only permission independent of system photo/video picker; lifecycle refresh and retry/settings routes. Unused broad Android library permissions removed.
